HighlighterSwift theme notices

These stylesheets are distributed in the Highlighter_Highlighter.bundle
resource bundle. Each stylesheet retains its upstream header. The source
is vendored from HighlighterSwift 3.1.0, commit
fe7aae9c9b31d3b296fd3d2dd575e1a207bb29e0:
https://github.com/smittytone/HighlighterSwift/tree/fe7aae9c9b31d3b296fd3d2dd575e1a207bb29e0/Sources/Assets/styles

Spookky normalized end-of-file whitespace. No theme rules were changed.
These theme files retain their respective licenses.

Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Full text: CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt in this notice directory.

- kimbie-dark.css and kimbie-light.css
  Kimbie by Jan T. Sott
  https://github.com/idleberg/Kimbie-highlight.js

- nnfx-dark.css and nnfx-light.css
  Copyright (c) 2020-2021 Jim Mason
  Maintainer: @RocketMan
  Theme version: 1.1.0
  The pinned source above includes both stylesheets and their attribution.
